# TryAWS.now

> TryAWS.now is a prepaid cloud panel for people and businesses in Bangladesh. You buy Cloud Servers, built on Amazon Lightsail, that run in the AWS Region Singapore or Mumbai. Prices are in US dollars and include VAT and fees; you pay in taka from a wallet that you top up with EPS. TryAWS.now sells, bills and supports the service.

> TryAWS.now বাংলাদেশের মানুষ ও প্রতিষ্ঠানের জন্য একটি প্রিপেইড ক্লাউড প্যানেল। এখানে Amazon Lightsail দিয়ে তৈরি ক্লাউড সার্ভার কেনা যায়, যা Singapore বা Mumbai AWS Region থেকে চলে। মূল্য মার্কিন ডলারে দেখানো হয় এবং তাতে VAT ও ফি অন্তর্ভুক্ত; পরিশোধ হয় টাকায়, ওয়ালেট থেকে, যা EPS দিয়ে টপ আপ করা যায়। বিক্রি, বিল ও সাপোর্ট TryAWS.now দেয়।

Canonical site: https://tryaws.now
Published by TiCON System Limited
Last updated: 2026-11-14

## Key facts

- What: Every server, database and storage resource you buy here is an Amazon Lightsail resource running in an AWS Region (Singapore or Mumbai). TryAWS.now sells, bills and supports the service. You manage everything from this panel and do not need an AWS account.
- Locations: Singapore (ap-southeast-1), Mumbai (ap-south-1)
- Prices: Prices are in US dollars (USD), for 30 days, and include VAT and fees. The amount in taka is worked out at checkout with the exchange rate of the day, and you see it before you confirm. 100% AWS infrastructure. Built on Amazon Lightsail.
- Support: TryAWS.now gives support through support requests only, and our support team answers every request in writing. With an account, open a request in the panel and follow the answers there. Without an account, use the form on the support page and we answer by email. There is no support phone line and no support email address.
- Company: TiCON System Limited, Level 6, House of Veritas, 8 Gareeb-e-Newaz Avenue, Sector-13, Uttara, Dhaka-1230
- Machine-readable facts: https://tryaws.now/facts.json
- Full text: https://tryaws.now/llms-full.txt
